sloka: त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां गताः सर्वे राक्षसा बलगर्विताः ।प्रयाता देवलोकाय योद्धुं दैवतशत्रवः ।। ७.६.४९ ॥
transliteration: tyaktvā laṅkāṁ gatāḥ sarve rākṣasā balagarvitāḥ ।prayātā devalokāya yoddhuṁ daivataśatravaḥ ।। 7.6.49 ॥

translations.english: All the Rākṣasas, proud of their strength and enemies of the gods, abandoned Lanka and set out for the world of the gods to fight.
